topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Well, now, it seems the good Lord has smiled on me this day, as I've found a trove of treasures right under my own roof! Not in the fields, where I toil day in and day out, but hidden away in the attic, where the sun seldom peeks. Books, and trinkets, and old garments, all left behind by them who once called this place home. I'll wager they've no need of such things now, and I, well, I see them as a blessing. A chance to perhaps barter or sell, to put a bit of coin in my pouch. It's not often a man like me, bound to the soil, finds a bit of fortune without the sweat of his brow. St. Francis must have guided my hand, for now, I may just see a bit easier through the winter.
